'''StarBank''' was a [[Bank/Legends|banking institution]] headquartered in [[Terminal 7]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. StarBank exchanged local currencies for [[Interstellar Credit]]s.
